assumptions: The stoichiometry chosen (1+1 Fab, 2+2 IgG); each chain keeps its own termini.
limits: Sequence-derived: glycosylation, which dominates a real antibody's mass, is not included.
Not the same as concatenating the chains, which is why the assembly is explicit.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the whole molecule's computed properties (mass, pI, charge, extinction), which the outputs carry; the Antibody panel shows them as readouts and writes no reading over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What are an assembled Fab's or IgG's mass, isoelectric point, charge at a pH, and extinction coefficient reduced and oxidised?

description: Properties of an assembled antibody from its heavy and light chains: molecular weight, isoelectric point, net charge at a pH, and the extinction coefficient and A280 with cysteines reduced and with every pair formed into a cystine, for a Fab (1 heavy + 1 light) or an IgG (2 + 2). Each chain keeps its own termini, so this is not the same as pasting the chains end to end. Graded against Biopython ProtParam over every heavy/light pair of ANARCI's PDB benchmark.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

format.description: how many copies of each chain the molecule holds. Values: fab (Fab (1 heavy + 1 light)), igg (IgG (2 heavy + 2 light)).

heavy.description: the heavy chain (one-letter amino acids), as much of it as the molecule carries.

light.description: the light chain (kappa or lambda, one-letter amino acids).

pH.description: the pH the net charge is reported at.

name: antibody_molecule

absorbance.description: A280 of a 1 g/L solution, `reduced` and `cystines`

chargeAtPH.description: net charge at the requested pH

isoelectricPoint.description: isoelectric point of the whole molecule (Bjellqvist pKs, each chain with its own termini)

molecularWeight.description: average mass of the whole molecule, Da (chains reduced)
